scale_rationale: train-fitted fields undershoot: at train poses the model has absorbed part of the misregistration into its geometry, so DIS sees only the unabsorbed remainder; at novel poses the full displacement appears. Scalar calibrated on PUBLIC test GT (sanctioned surface), fields still fit on private TRAIN photos only.
smooth_rationale: median-over-views leaves per-cell estimator noise in the ds=8 field; gaussian sigma=2 on that grid, renormalised to the same mean |f|, measured +0.0146 (t=9.27, 55/60) on the production harness through the full shipped chain. Interior optimum: sigma 4 is a wash, sigma 10 is -0.27.
